arms.purpose: Richer persistent-leaf history, same learned width
Same existing full-feature continuation. Disclose smaller capacity where present

before_registration_required.requirement: Root must fill/freeze all hashes, exact cohort/parent counts, available inference-error strata and budget before a substantive experiment.

decoding.false_short_bp_per_Mb: Incorrect-label bp inside those runs / total evaluated bp *1000000.
decoding.false_short_count_per_Mb: Such predicted runs with any wrong-label overlap / total evaluated bp *1000000.
decoding.false_short_switch: Predicted interior run<=10000bp whose immediate flanks have the same different predicted label.
decoding.match_ties: Root-frozen deterministic evaluator resolves remaining ties before registration.
decoding.probabilities: Common existing readout, no posthoc smoothing. Argmax ties choose smallest fixed class index.
decoding.support: Exact shared spans in bp. Exclude clipped endpoint runs from tract denominators and report excluded counts/bp.
decoding.true_short_retention: Fraction of true interior runs<=10000bp matched one-to-one to correct-label predicted runs with IoU>=.5 and both boundaries within1000bp. Maximize matched count then IoU.

falsification: No authenticated informative shared identity blocks the condition.
Gain over alpha1 alone, without fixed/count gain, does not support identity utility.
True-short loss beyond2percentage points or worsened boundaries rejects useful tradeoff.
No advantage with same full-feature controls rejects information-gain claim.
Producer/parameter/budget/smoothing/target-matching changes cannot be credited to this gate.

fixed_conditions.body: Same existing whole-tree message passing, times/topology/features, GRU and readout. No new GRU.
fixed_conditions.bootstrap: Identical explicit first-two-cut bootstrap, reset/window/detach/truncation. Unchanged-cut holds preserve forcing.
fixed_conditions.carriers: AB->BC occupied cells vs H stable-leaf slots. Report state and activation storage separately.
fixed_conditions.clock: Existing H050 bp condition in every arm, no simultaneous Morgan ablation.
fixed_conditions.full_feature_controls: Primary comparisons use identical full-tree features. Added information relative only to cuts is insufficient.
fixed_conditions.maps: Same U/O feature widths, learned scale dimensions and matching parameter initialization for memory arms. Gates parameter-free.
fixed_conditions.observations: Same frozen inferred trees, reference/query split, native support and biological truth across paired arms.
fixed_conditions.optimizer_budget: Root freezes exact FP32 optimizer/schedule/budget/stopping/common warmstart before registration. No fit authorized.
fixed_conditions.resource_policy: Any future run follows latest user device policy and root admission. This package launches no GPU or scientific benchmark.
fixed_conditions.trees: All genuine marginal trees/retained vertices/unary paths/leaves.

hypothesis: Within one authenticated shared-ID inferred-tree condition, boundary-edge equality improves false short-tract burden beyond fixed/count shrinkage without materially reducing true-short retention.
limitations: No complete model/data loader/sequence scan/trainer/biological result.
No checkpoint/truth read, GPU run, admission or experiment registration.
Contraction is a carry property in leaf/count-weighted norm.
Endpoint persistence is inferred bookkeeping, not calibrated ancestry confidence.
novelty_position: Mechanism utility only. Conditional expectation, shrinkage, shared identity, graph-plus-GRU and graph memory are established.
optional_diagnostics: Observation-only identity availability/redundancy audit before targets.
Clearly synthetic sham correspondence breaks identity with membership marginals fixed, never presented as true inferred graph.
Any new comparator/producer needs separate root source review/registration.

primary_decision.aggregation: Equal-weight independent parent metrics within seed then equal-weight5seeds. Paired parent bootstrap across arms retains all windows/paired seeds.
primary_decision.burden: Edge vs fixed_half and count must have negative paired false_short_bp_per_Mb difference with simultaneous95% upper bounds below0.
primary_decision.multiplicity: Bonferroni one-sided alpha=.05/5 across2burden superiority and3retention noninferiority contrasts.
primary_decision.reporting: Parent counts, seed sample SD with units, each seed and paired intervals. Empty short denominators/insufficient independent parents are inconclusive.
primary_decision.retention: Edge vs triple, fixed_half and count true-short recall difference must exceed-.02 with simultaneous95% lower bounds.

secondary_outcomes: False short switch count/Mb and incorrect bp in all short predicted runs/Mb
True-short tract and correct-label bp recall in(0,1kb],(1,5kb],(5,10kb]
Exact-span accuracy, NLL, multiclass Brier and fixed-bin calibration
Parameters, occupied counts, timing and peak state/activation memory only in later authorized runs
source_feasibility_gates: Authenticate observed inferred-tskit hash, builder, intervals, persistent joins and exact node namespace.
Sidecar must contain actual adjacent native cut-boundary (parent,child) keys. Root/missing=(-1,-1). No row IDs, clade/time reconstructions or packed-key aliases.
Before outcomes, audit continuity availability, nonzero variation, gate degeneracy and redundancy with full times/topology/order.
Default official Relate exporter creates fresh internal nodes each marginal tree. Block this source condition if identity is unavailable/uninformative.
Any changed shared-ID producer must be common to all arms and disclosed as a changed observation/pipeline condition.
Authenticate builder target-free lineage. A provenance assertion alone is insufficient.

split_and_tuning.error_strata: Root freezes available error conditions before fitting, not selected from test gains.
split_and_tuning.seal: Freeze evaluator and arm predictions before test target access. Targets are evaluator-only.
split_and_tuning.tuning: No TEST tuning. Alpha=.5, prior16, thresholds and retention margin fixed here. No outcome-derived matching.
split_and_tuning.unit: Replicate/subject parent split before windows, no parent crosses TRAIN/VAL/TEST.
